title: The AI Feature That Nobody Is Talking About
angle: Most people obsess over ChatGPT prompts — but there is a silent background feature quietly rewriting how AI remembers YOU, and almost no one has turned it on.

scenes.voiceover: There is one AI feature that changes everything — and 99% of users have never touched it.
scenes.visual_description: Bold white text on black: '99% of AI users are missing THIS.' Hard cut to a blinking cursor on a blank screen.

scenes.voiceover: Every time you open ChatGPT, it forgets you. Your job, your goals, your style — gone. You start from zero.
scenes.visual_description: Screen shows a fresh ChatGPT chat. User types 'Remember when I told you...' — AI replies 'I don't have context from previous conversations.'
scenes.caption_overlay: It forgets you. Every. Single. Time.

scenes.voiceover: But buried in settings — Memory. AI builds a permanent profile of you. It learns. It adapts. It never forgets.
scenes.visual_description: Fast zoom into ChatGPT settings panel. Cursor clicks 'Personalization' then 'Memory' — toggle switches ON with a green flash.
scenes.caption_overlay: It's been hiding in plain sight.

scenes.voiceover: Watch. I tell it I'm a startup founder who hates fluff. Next session — it already knows. Zero briefing needed.
scenes.visual_description: Split screen: left shows memory being saved in real time, right shows a new chat session where AI opens with tailored, concise founder-focused advice unprompted.
scenes.caption_overlay: It already knows who you are.

scenes.voiceover: This isn't a gimmick. People using Memory are saving hours weekly. Everyone else is just... repeating themselves.
scenes.visual_description: Rapid-fire text cuts: 'HOURS SAVED' — 'PERSONALISED OUTPUT' — 'EVERYONE ELSE: COPY-PASTING THE SAME PROMPT FOREVER.' Red and white color palette.
scenes.caption_overlay: The gap between users is growing fast.

scenes.voiceover: So — are you still in the 99%? Go to Settings, Personalization, Memory. Turn it on. You're welcome.
scenes.visual_description: Final frame echoes the opening: bold text on black — 'Still missing it?' then hard cut to green toggle switched ON. Loops back to opening frame.
scenes.caption_overlay: Settings → Personalization → Memory. Do it now.

hook_test.format_reference: Wait, what? — Hook with surprising claim → proof → bigger reveal
hook_test.viral_proof: Videos using the '99% of people don't know this' structure in the AI/tech space have repeatedly crossed 10M+ views on TikTok — including MattVidPro AI and similar creators whose 'hidden ChatGPT feature' format videos consistently hit 8-15M views with sub-5s hooks on bold-text claim openings.
hook_test.why_it_works: The '99% are missing this' frame triggers immediate identity threat — viewers must self-sort. Combined with a concrete, actionable reveal (a real settings toggle), it delivers dopamine on proof. The loop ending rewards rewatchers, boosting completion rate which feeds the algorithm.
